<!--
Template shipped with the zfbehavior package (inst/skills/dataset-import-qc/).
Do not edit the analysis code below for a specific study -- put every
study-specific choice in dataset-import-qc.yml and render with:

  quarto render dataset-import-qc.qmd --execute-params dataset-import-qc.yml

This document only calls exported zfbehavior functions. See
inst/skills/CONVENTIONS.md for the run-folder / naming / manifest rules.
-->

```{r}
#| label: setup
#| include: false

library(zfbehavior)

p <- params
skill <- "dataset-import-qc"

stop_param <- function(msg) {
  stop("dataset-import-qc parameter error: ", msg, call. = FALSE)
}

if (is.null(p$run_label) || !grepl("^[A-Za-z0-9_-]+$", p$run_label)) {
  stop_param("`run_label` is required (letters, digits, '-', '_').")
}
if (is.null(p$column_mapping) || length(p$column_mapping) == 0) {
  stop_param("`column_mapping` is required (confirm it with the user).")
}
if (is.null(p$input)) stop_param("`input` is required.")
for (nm in c("expected_row_count", "expected_vc_wells", "expected_dose_wells")) {
  if (is.null(p$plate_qc[[nm]])) {
    stop_param(paste0("`plate_qc$", nm, "` is required (no default is assumed)."))
  }
}
if (!is.null(p$input$format) &&
    !p$input$format %in% c("one_file_per_plate", "single_file", "sheet_per_plate")) {
  stop_param("`input$format` must be one_file_per_plate, single_file, or sheet_per_plate.")
}

project_root <- normalizePath(p$project_root, mustWork = TRUE)
out_dir <- "outputs"
dir.create(out_dir, showWarnings = FALSE)

out_path <- function(object, ext) {
  file.path(out_dir, paste0(skill, "__", p$run_label, "__", object, ".", ext))
}
# CONVENTIONS.md section 2: every table saved to outputs/ is a tibble,
# including tables one level inside a saved list / result object.
save_rds <- function(x, path) {
  as_tbl <- function(v) if (is.data.frame(v) && !inherits(v, "tbl_df")) tibble::as_tibble(v) else v
  x <- as_tbl(x)
  if (is.list(x) && !is.data.frame(x)) {
    cls <- class(x)
    x[] <- lapply(x, as_tbl)
    class(x) <- cls
  }
  saveRDS(x, path)
}

as_chr <- function(x) if (is.null(x)) character(0) else unlist(x, use.names = FALSE)

# Quarto may deliver a yml list of maps as a data.frame or a list of lists;
# normalize to a data.frame with the requested character columns.
as_entry_table <- function(x, cols, what) {
  empty <- as.data.frame(
    stats::setNames(rep(list(character(0)), length(cols)), cols),
    stringsAsFactors = FALSE
  )
  if (is.null(x) || length(x) == 0) return(empty)
  get_col <- function(nm) {
    if (is.data.frame(x)) {
      v <- x[[nm]]
      if (is.null(v)) rep(NA_character_, nrow(x)) else as.character(v)
    } else {
      vapply(x, function(e) {
        if (is.null(e[[nm]])) NA_character_ else as.character(e[[nm]])
      }, "")
    }
  }
  out <- as.data.frame(stats::setNames(lapply(cols, get_col), cols), stringsAsFactors = FALSE)
  for (nm in cols) {
    v <- out[[nm]]
    if (any(is.na(v) | !nzchar(trimws(v)))) {
      stop_param(paste0("every `", what, "` entry needs a non-empty `", nm, "`."))
    }
  }
  out
}

well_cols <- c("plate_id", "well_id", "reason")
well_key <- function(df) paste(df$plate_id, df$well_id, sep = "@@")

check_no_dup_wells <- function(tbl, what) {
  dup <- unique(well_key(tbl)[duplicated(well_key(tbl))])
  if (length(dup) > 0) {
    stop_param(paste0("`", what, "` lists a well more than once: ",
                      paste(sub("@@", "/", dup), collapse = ", ")))
  }
}

kw_source <- if (is.null(p$keep_well$source)) "column" else as.character(p$keep_well$source)
if (!kw_source %in% c("column", "derived")) {
  stop_param("`keep_well$source` must be `column` or `derived`.")
}
false_wells_tbl <- as_entry_table(p$keep_well$false_wells, well_cols, "keep_well$false_wells")
if (kw_source == "column" && nrow(false_wells_tbl) > 0) {
  stop_param("`keep_well$false_wells` is only used with `keep_well$source: derived`.")
}
if (kw_source == "derived") {
  if (!is.null(p$column_mapping$keep_well)) {
    stop_param("with `keep_well$source: derived`, do not map keep_well in `column_mapping`.")
  }
  if (!"keep_well" %in% as_chr(p$optional_roles)) {
    stop_param("with `keep_well$source: derived`, add keep_well to `optional_roles`.")
  }
}
provider_removed_tbl <- as_entry_table(p$provider_removed_wells, well_cols, "provider_removed_wells")
remove_wells_tbl <- as_entry_table(p$remove_wells, well_cols, "remove_wells")
keep_flagged_tbl <- as_entry_table(p$keep_flagged_wells, well_cols, "keep_flagged_wells")
check_no_dup_wells(false_wells_tbl, "keep_well$false_wells")
check_no_dup_wells(provider_removed_tbl, "provider_removed_wells")
check_no_dup_wells(remove_wells_tbl, "remove_wells")
check_no_dup_wells(keep_flagged_tbl, "keep_flagged_wells")
both_lists <- intersect(well_key(remove_wells_tbl), well_key(keep_flagged_tbl))
if (length(both_lists) > 0) {
  stop_param(paste0("well(s) listed in both `remove_wells` and `keep_flagged_wells`: ",
                    paste(sub("@@", "/", both_lists), collapse = ", ")))
}
flag_col <- p$flag_comment_column
flag_pattern <- p$flag_comment_pattern
if (xor(is.null(flag_col), is.null(flag_pattern))) {
  stop_param("`flag_comment_column` and `flag_comment_pattern` must be given together.")
}
```

## Run

- Skill: `dataset-import-qc`
- Run label: **`r p$run_label`**
- zfbehavior version: `r as.character(utils::packageVersion("zfbehavior"))`
- Rendered: `r format(Sys.time(), "%Y-%m-%d %H:%M:%S")`

## Inputs

```{r}
#| label: resolve-inputs

resolve_from_root <- function(x) {
  ifelse(grepl("^(/|~|[A-Za-z]:)", x), path.expand(x), file.path(project_root, x))
}

input_files <- character(0)
if (length(as_chr(p$input$files)) > 0) {
  input_files <- resolve_from_root(as_chr(p$input$files))
}
if (!is.null(p$input$pattern)) {
  pat_dir <- resolve_from_root(dirname(p$input$pattern))
  pat_glob <- utils::glob2rx(basename(p$input$pattern))
  input_files <- c(input_files, list.files(pat_dir, pattern = pat_glob, full.names = TRUE))
}
# Keep paths as given relative to the project root (do NOT resolve symlinks,
# e.g. data/raw/<batch> linked to shared storage), so the manifest records
# project-relative input paths.
input_files <- sort(unique(input_files))

if (length(input_files) == 0) {
  stop_param("no input files found (check `input$files` / `input$pattern`).")
}
missing_files <- input_files[!file.exists(input_files)]
if (length(missing_files) > 0) {
  stop_param(paste0("input file(s) not found: ", paste(missing_files, collapse = ", ")))
}

input_format <- if (is.null(p$input$format)) "one_file_per_plate" else p$input$format

# One "read unit" per file, or per file x sheet for sheet_per_plate.
read_units <- if (input_format == "sheet_per_plate") {
  do.call(rbind, lapply(input_files, function(f) {
    sheets <- as_chr(p$input$sheets)
    if (length(sheets) == 0) sheets <- readxl::excel_sheets(f)
    data.frame(file = f, sheet = sheets, stringsAsFactors = FALSE)
  }))
} else {
  sheet1 <- as_chr(p$input$sheets)
  data.frame(
    file = input_files,
    sheet = if (length(sheet1) > 0) sheet1[[1]] else NA_character_,
    stringsAsFactors = FALSE
  )
}

knitr::kable(
  data.frame(
    format = input_format,
    n_files = length(input_files),
    n_read_units = nrow(read_units)
  ),
  caption = "Input summary."
)
```

## Import

Each read unit is imported with `read_behavior_data()` (strict parsing:
any parse/coercion problem is an error, recorded per file rather than
stopping the whole run).

```{r}
#| label: import

col_types <- as_chr(p$col_types)
optional_roles <- as_chr(p$optional_roles)
dtv <- p$derive_time_value_from_binning
# YAML 1.1 writers may emit yes/no, which Quarto passes through as strings.
if (is.character(dtv) && tolower(dtv) %in% c("yes", "true", "on")) dtv <- TRUE
if (is.character(dtv) && tolower(dtv) %in% c("no", "false", "off")) dtv <- FALSE
derive_time <- isTRUE(dtv) || is.character(dtv)
binning_col <- if (is.character(dtv)) dtv else "BINNING"

import_one <- function(file, sheet) {
  ext <- tolower(tools::file_ext(file))
  is_excel <- ext %in% c("xlsx", "xls")
  args <- list(
    path = file,
    column_mapping = p$column_mapping,
    optional_roles = if (length(optional_roles) > 0) optional_roles else NULL
  )
  if (is_excel) {
    if (!is.na(sheet)) args$sheet <- sheet
    if (length(col_types) > 0) args$excel_col_types <- col_types
  } else if (length(col_types) > 0) {
    # Same yml vocabulary as Excel (text/numeric/logical) -> readr compact codes.
    codes <- c(text = "c", numeric = "d", logical = "l")[col_types]
    if (anyNA(codes)) {
      stop_param("`col_types` for CSV/TSV input may only use text, numeric, logical.")
    }
    args$delimited_col_types <- paste(unname(codes), collapse = "")
  }
  d <- do.call(read_behavior_data, args)
  if (derive_time) {
    if (!binning_col %in% names(d)) {
      stop("time-bin column `", binning_col, "` not found in ", basename(file), call. = FALSE)
    }
    d$time_value <- parse_binning_to_time(d[[binning_col]])
  }
  d$source_file <- basename(file)
  if (!is.na(sheet)) d$source_sheet <- sheet
  d
}

imports <- lapply(seq_len(nrow(read_units)), function(i) {
  u <- read_units[i, ]
  res <- tryCatch(import_one(u$file, u$sheet), error = function(e) e)
  list(file = basename(u$file), sheet = u$sheet, result = res)
})

import_log <- data.frame(
  file = vapply(imports, `[[`, "", "file"),
  sheet = vapply(imports, function(x) as.character(x$sheet), ""),
  ok = vapply(imports, function(x) !inherits(x$result, "error"), TRUE),
  n_rows = vapply(imports, function(x) {
    if (inherits(x$result, "error")) NA_integer_ else nrow(x$result)
  }, 1L),
  error = vapply(imports, function(x) {
    if (inherits(x$result, "error")) {
      paste0("[", class(x$result)[1], "] ", conditionMessage(x$result))
    } else {
      ""
    }
  }, ""),
  stringsAsFactors = FALSE
)

knitr::kable(import_log, caption = "Import log (one row per read unit).")
```

## Per-plate QC

Data are split by `plate_id` (even within a single file) and each plate is
checked with `validate_behavior_data()` using the expected counts from the
run's yml.

```{r}
#| label: per-plate-qc

imported <- do.call(
  rbind,
  lapply(Filter(function(x) !inherits(x$result, "error"), imports), function(x) {
    as.data.frame(x$result)
  })
)
imported <- if (is.null(imported)) NULL else tibble::as_tibble(imported)

# keep_well source: derived -> FALSE only for the user-listed wells.
if (!is.null(imported) && kw_source == "derived") {
  if ("keep_well" %in% names(imported)) {
    stop_param("`keep_well$source: derived`, but the imported data already has a keep_well column.")
  }
  present_keys <- unique(well_key(imported))
  unknown_fw <- setdiff(well_key(false_wells_tbl), present_keys)
  if (length(unknown_fw) > 0) {
    stop_param(paste0("`keep_well$false_wells` lists well(s) not in the data: ",
                      paste(sub("@@", "/", unknown_fw), collapse = ", ")))
  }
  imported$keep_well <- !(well_key(imported) %in% well_key(false_wells_tbl))
}

plate_results <- list()
if (!is.null(imported)) {
  for (pid in sort(unique(imported$plate_id))) {
    d_plate <- imported[imported$plate_id %in% pid, , drop = FALSE]
    qc <- validate_behavior_data(
      d_plate,
      expected_row_count = p$plate_qc$expected_row_count,
      expected_vc_wells = p$plate_qc$expected_vc_wells,
      expected_dose_wells = p$plate_qc$expected_dose_wells
    )
    plate_results[[as.character(pid)]] <- qc
  }
}

plate_qc_table <- do.call(rbind, lapply(names(plate_results), function(pid) {
  qc <- plate_results[[pid]]
  bad <- qc$checks[qc$checks$status != "passed", , drop = FALSE]
  data.frame(
    plate_id = pid,
    source_file = paste(unique(imported$source_file[imported$plate_id %in% pid]), collapse = "; "),
    ok = qc$ok,
    issues = if (nrow(bad) == 0) "" else paste0(
      "[", bad$status, "] ", bad$code, ": ", bad$message, collapse = " | "
    ),
    accepted_with_provider_removed_wells = FALSE,
    stringsAsFactors = FALSE
  )
}))
if (is.null(plate_qc_table)) {
  plate_qc_table <- data.frame(
    plate_id = character(0), source_file = character(0),
    ok = logical(0), issues = character(0),
    accepted_with_provider_removed_wells = logical(0)
  )
}

# Provider-removed wells: a plate is accepted only if (a) every declared well
# is absent, (b) its ONLY failed checks are the count checks, and (c) the
# row/VC/dose shortfalls are explained exactly by the declared wells.
count_codes <- c("plate_row_counts", "vc_replicate_counts", "dose_replicate_counts")
provider_removed_check <- data.frame(
  plate_id = character(0), n_declared = integer(0), accepted = logical(0),
  detail = character(0), stringsAsFactors = FALSE
)
if (nrow(provider_removed_tbl) > 0) {
  unknown_pr <- setdiff(provider_removed_tbl$plate_id, plate_qc_table$plate_id)
  if (length(unknown_pr) > 0) {
    stop_param(paste0("`provider_removed_wells` lists unknown plate_id(s): ",
                      paste(unknown_pr, collapse = ", ")))
  }
  n_time <- length(unique(imported$time_value))
  for (pid in unique(provider_removed_tbl$plate_id)) {
    decl <- provider_removed_tbl[provider_removed_tbl$plate_id == pid, , drop = FALSE]
    d_plate <- imported[imported$plate_id %in% pid, , drop = FALSE]
    qc <- plate_results[[pid]]
    problems <- character(0)

    still_present <- intersect(well_key(decl), unique(well_key(d_plate)))
    if (length(still_present) > 0) {
      problems <- c(problems, paste0("declared-removed well(s) still present: ",
                                     paste(sub("^.*@@", "", still_present), collapse = ", ")))
    }
    other_fail <- qc$checks$code[qc$checks$status != "passed" & !qc$checks$code %in% count_codes]
    if (length(other_fail) > 0) {
      problems <- c(problems, paste0("non-count check(s) failed: ", paste(other_fail, collapse = ", ")))
    }
    n_wells_present <- length(unique(d_plate$well_id))
    exp_rows <- p$plate_qc$expected_row_count
    if (nrow(d_plate) != exp_rows - nrow(decl) * n_time) {
      problems <- c(problems, paste0(
        "row count ", nrow(d_plate), " != expected ", exp_rows, " - ",
        nrow(decl), " declared well(s) x ", n_time, " timepoints"
      ))
    }
    if (exp_rows %% n_time == 0 && n_wells_present != exp_rows / n_time - nrow(decl)) {
      problems <- c(problems, paste0(
        n_wells_present, " wells present, expected ", exp_rows / n_time - nrow(decl)
      ))
    }
    # VC / dose shortfall: every stratum below the expected count must be
    # explained by declared wells. The declared wells' own design (VC vs dose)
    # is unknown because they are absent, so compare totals per plate.
    vc_diag <- qc$diagnostics$vc_replicate_counts
    dose_diag <- qc$diagnostics$dose_replicate_counts
    vc_short <- if (is.null(vc_diag)) 0 else
      sum(pmax(0, p$plate_qc$expected_vc_wells - vc_diag$n_vc_wells)) / n_time
    dose_short <- if (is.null(dose_diag)) 0 else
      sum(pmax(0, p$plate_qc$expected_dose_wells - dose_diag$n_wells)) / n_time
    vc_over <- if (is.null(vc_diag)) 0 else sum(vc_diag$n_vc_wells > p$plate_qc$expected_vc_wells)
    dose_over <- if (is.null(dose_diag)) 0 else sum(dose_diag$n_wells > p$plate_qc$expected_dose_wells)
    if (vc_over + dose_over > 0) {
      problems <- c(problems, "some VC/dose strata have MORE wells than expected")
    }
    if (vc_short + dose_short != nrow(decl)) {
      problems <- c(problems, paste0(
        "VC + dose well shortfall (", vc_short, " + ", dose_short,
        ") != ", nrow(decl), " declared well(s)"
      ))
    }
    accepted <- length(problems) == 0
    provider_removed_check <- rbind(provider_removed_check, data.frame(
      plate_id = pid, n_declared = nrow(decl), accepted = accepted,
      detail = if (accepted) {
        paste0("shortfall explained: ", vc_short, " VC + ", dose_short, " dose well(s)")
      } else {
        paste(problems, collapse = "; ")
      },
      stringsAsFactors = FALSE
    ))
    if (accepted && !plate_qc_table$ok[plate_qc_table$plate_id == pid]) {
      plate_qc_table$ok[plate_qc_table$plate_id == pid] <- TRUE
      plate_qc_table$accepted_with_provider_removed_wells[plate_qc_table$plate_id == pid] <- TRUE
    }
  }
  if (any(!provider_removed_check$accepted)) {
    # A declaration that does not match the data is a review item, not an
    # automatic acceptance: mark those plates as failed.
    bad_pr <- provider_removed_check$plate_id[!provider_removed_check$accepted]
    plate_qc_table$ok[plate_qc_table$plate_id %in% bad_pr] <- FALSE
    plate_qc_table$issues[plate_qc_table$plate_id %in% bad_pr] <- paste0(
      plate_qc_table$issues[plate_qc_table$plate_id %in% bad_pr],
      " | provider_removed_wells declaration does not match: ",
      provider_removed_check$detail[match(plate_qc_table$plate_id[plate_qc_table$plate_id %in% bad_pr],
                                          provider_removed_check$plate_id)]
    )
  }
}

knitr::kable(
  data.frame(
    plates = nrow(plate_qc_table),
    passed = sum(plate_qc_table$ok),
    failed = sum(!plate_qc_table$ok),
    import_errors = sum(!import_log$ok)
  ),
  caption = "Per-plate QC summary."
)
```

```{r}
#| label: failed-plates

failed_plates <- plate_qc_table[!plate_qc_table$ok, , drop = FALSE]
if (nrow(failed_plates) > 0) {
  knitr::kable(failed_plates, caption = "Plates that FAILED per-plate QC.")
} else {
  cat("All plates passed per-plate QC.\n")
}
```

```{r}
#| label: provider-removed

if (nrow(provider_removed_check) > 0) {
  knitr::kable(
    provider_removed_check,
    caption = paste(
      "Plates with wells the provider already removed (declared in",
      "`provider_removed_wells`). Accepted only when the count shortfall",
      "matches the declaration exactly and no other check failed."
    )
  )
}
```

## Exclusions (human decision)

```{r}
#| label: exclusions

excl <- p$exclude_plates
# Quarto may deliver a yml list of {plate_id, reason} maps either as a
# data.frame or as a list of lists -- normalize both.
excl_table <- if (is.null(excl) || length(excl) == 0) {
  data.frame(plate_id = character(0), reason = character(0))
} else if (is.data.frame(excl)) {
  data.frame(
    plate_id = as.character(excl$plate_id),
    reason = if (is.null(excl$reason)) NA_character_ else as.character(excl$reason),
    stringsAsFactors = FALSE
  )
} else {
  data.frame(
    plate_id = vapply(excl, function(x) as.character(x$plate_id), ""),
    reason = vapply(excl, function(x) {
      if (is.null(x$reason)) NA_character_ else as.character(x$reason)
    }, ""),
    stringsAsFactors = FALSE
  )
}
if (nrow(excl_table) > 0 && any(is.na(excl_table$plate_id) | !nzchar(excl_table$plate_id))) {
  stop_param("every `exclude_plates` entry needs a `plate_id`.")
}
excl_table$reason[!is.na(excl_table$reason) & !nzchar(trimws(excl_table$reason))] <- NA_character_
if (any(is.na(excl_table$reason))) {
  stop_param("every `exclude_plates` entry needs a non-empty `reason`.")
}
unknown_excl <- setdiff(excl_table$plate_id, plate_qc_table$plate_id)
if (length(unknown_excl) > 0) {
  stop_param(paste0("`exclude_plates` lists unknown plate_id(s): ", paste(unknown_excl, collapse = ", ")))
}

unresolved <- setdiff(failed_plates$plate_id, excl_table$plate_id)

if (nrow(excl_table) > 0) {
  knitr::kable(excl_table, caption = "Plates excluded by user decision (from the run's yml).")
} else {
  cat("No plates excluded.\n")
}
```

## Well curation (exactly one larva per well)

The combined output must contain only wells holding exactly one larva, so
that `keep_well = FALSE` means "one larva, dead/malformed" and every well in
the output counts toward the denominator. `keep_well` source:
**`r kw_source`**.

```{r}
#| label: well-curation

well_info_cols <- intersect(
  c("plate_id", "well_id", "is_vehicle_control", "concentration", "keep_well", flag_col),
  names(imported)
)
well_info <- if (is.null(imported)) {
  data.frame(plate_id = character(0), well_id = character(0), stringsAsFactors = FALSE)
} else {
  unique(imported[, well_info_cols, drop = FALSE])
}
if (anyDuplicated(well_key(well_info))) {
  # A flag/comment column that varies within a well: keep the first value per
  # well for display (per-plate QC already reports well-level invariants).
  well_info <- well_info[!duplicated(well_key(well_info)), , drop = FALSE]
}
present_keys <- well_key(well_info)

unknown_rm <- setdiff(well_key(remove_wells_tbl), present_keys)
if (length(unknown_rm) > 0) {
  stop_param(paste0("`remove_wells` lists well(s) not in the data: ",
                    paste(sub("@@", "/", unknown_rm), collapse = ", ")))
}
unknown_kf <- setdiff(well_key(keep_flagged_tbl), present_keys)
if (length(unknown_kf) > 0) {
  stop_param(paste0("`keep_flagged_wells` lists well(s) not in the data: ",
                    paste(sub("@@", "/", unknown_kf), collapse = ", ")))
}

# Candidate finder (never removes anything by itself).
flagged <- well_info[0, , drop = FALSE]
if (!is.null(flag_col) && !is.null(imported)) {
  if (!flag_col %in% names(imported)) {
    stop_param(paste0("`flag_comment_column` `", flag_col, "` not found in the imported data."))
  }
  hit <- !is.na(well_info[[flag_col]]) &
    grepl(flag_pattern, well_info[[flag_col]], ignore.case = TRUE)
  flagged <- well_info[hit, , drop = FALSE]
}
flagged$resolution <- ifelse(
  well_key(flagged) %in% well_key(remove_wells_tbl), "removed",
  ifelse(well_key(flagged) %in% well_key(keep_flagged_tbl), "kept (confirmed one larva)", "UNRESOLVED")
)
flagged$resolution[flagged$resolution == "UNRESOLVED" &
                     flagged$plate_id %in% excl_table$plate_id] <- "plate excluded"
unresolved_flagged <- flagged[flagged$resolution == "UNRESOLVED", , drop = FALSE]

if (!is.null(flag_col)) {
  cat("Comment flag: column `", flag_col, "`, pattern `", flag_pattern, "` -> ",
      nrow(flagged), " well(s) flagged, ", nrow(unresolved_flagged), " unresolved.\n", sep = "")
  if (nrow(flagged) > 0) {
    knitr::kable(flagged[order(flagged$resolution != "UNRESOLVED", flagged$plate_id, flagged$well_id), ],
                 row.names = FALSE, caption = "Wells flagged by the comment pattern.")
  }
} else {
  cat("No comment flag configured.\n")
}
```

```{r}
#| label: removed-wells-table

removed_detail <- if (nrow(remove_wells_tbl) > 0) {
  merge(remove_wells_tbl, well_info, by = c("plate_id", "well_id"), all.x = TRUE, sort = TRUE)
} else {
  NULL
}
if (!is.null(removed_detail)) {
  knitr::kable(removed_detail, row.names = FALSE,
               caption = "Wells removed from the output (`remove_wells`, user decision).")
} else {
  cat("No wells removed (`remove_wells` is empty).\n")
}
if (nrow(keep_flagged_tbl) > 0) {
  knitr::kable(keep_flagged_tbl, row.names = FALSE,
               caption = "Flagged wells confirmed as exactly one larva (`keep_flagged_wells`).")
}
if (kw_source == "derived") {
  knitr::kable(false_wells_tbl, row.names = FALSE,
                caption = "keep_well derived: wells set to FALSE (`keep_well$false_wells`); all others TRUE.")
}
```

## Vehicle-control usability per plate

Per plate, after well curation: kept vehicle-control wells / vehicle-control
wells present. A plate with **no** kept vehicle-control well is always
flagged (it cannot take part in any vehicle-control comparison or
normalization); with `min_kept_vc_pct` set, a plate below that percentage is
flagged too. Each flagged plate must be excluded or accepted (with a reason).

```{r}
#| label: vc-usability

min_vc_pct <- p$min_kept_vc_pct
if (!is.null(min_vc_pct)) {
  min_vc_pct <- suppressWarnings(as.numeric(min_vc_pct))
  if (length(min_vc_pct) != 1 || !is.finite(min_vc_pct) || min_vc_pct < 0 || min_vc_pct > 100) {
    stop_param("`min_kept_vc_pct` must be a number between 0 and 100 (or null).")
  }
}
accept_low_vc_tbl <- as_entry_table(p$accept_low_vc_plates, c("plate_id", "reason"), "accept_low_vc_plates")
if (anyDuplicated(accept_low_vc_tbl$plate_id)) {
  stop_param("`accept_low_vc_plates` lists a plate more than once.")
}

vc_usability <- data.frame(
  plate_id = character(0), n_vc_wells = integer(0), n_vc_kept = integer(0),
  pct_vc_kept = numeric(0), flagged = logical(0), stringsAsFactors = FALSE
)
if (!is.null(imported)) {
  wl <- unique(imported[!well_key(imported) %in% well_key(remove_wells_tbl),
                        c("plate_id", "well_id", "is_vehicle_control", "keep_well")])
  pids <- sort(unique(wl$plate_id))
  n_vc <- vapply(pids, function(x) sum(wl$plate_id == x & wl$is_vehicle_control), 1L)
  n_vc_kept <- vapply(pids, function(x) sum(wl$plate_id == x & wl$is_vehicle_control & wl$keep_well), 1L)
  pct <- ifelse(n_vc > 0, n_vc_kept / n_vc * 100, 0)
  vc_usability <- data.frame(
    plate_id = pids, n_vc_wells = unname(n_vc), n_vc_kept = unname(n_vc_kept),
    pct_vc_kept = round(unname(pct), 2),
    flagged = unname(n_vc_kept == 0 | (if (is.null(min_vc_pct)) FALSE else pct < min_vc_pct)),
    stringsAsFactors = FALSE
  )
}
unknown_alv <- setdiff(accept_low_vc_tbl$plate_id, vc_usability$plate_id)
if (length(unknown_alv) > 0) {
  stop_param(paste0("`accept_low_vc_plates` lists unknown plate_id(s): ", paste(unknown_alv, collapse = ", ")))
}
zero_vc_accepted <- intersect(accept_low_vc_tbl$plate_id, vc_usability$plate_id[vc_usability$n_vc_kept == 0])
if (length(zero_vc_accepted) > 0) {
  stop_param(paste0("plate(s) with NO kept vehicle-control well cannot be accepted, only excluded: ",
                    paste(zero_vc_accepted, collapse = ", ")))
}
vc_usability$resolution <- ifelse(
  !vc_usability$flagged, "",
  ifelse(vc_usability$plate_id %in% excl_table$plate_id, "plate excluded",
         ifelse(vc_usability$plate_id %in% accept_low_vc_tbl$plate_id, "accepted", "UNRESOLVED"))
)
unresolved_low_vc <- vc_usability$plate_id[vc_usability$resolution == "UNRESOLVED"]

if (nrow(vc_usability) > 0) {
  knitr::kable(data.frame(
    plates = nrow(vc_usability),
    threshold_pct = if (is.null(min_vc_pct)) "none (zero kept VC only)" else as.character(min_vc_pct),
    min_pct = min(vc_usability$pct_vc_kept),
    median_pct = stats::median(vc_usability$pct_vc_kept),
    flagged = sum(vc_usability$flagged),
    unresolved = length(unresolved_low_vc)
  ), caption = "Kept vehicle-control wells per plate (after well curation).")
}
```

```{r}
#| label: vc-usability-flagged

flagged_vc <- vc_usability[vc_usability$flagged, , drop = FALSE]
if (nrow(flagged_vc) > 0) {
  flagged_vc <- merge(flagged_vc, accept_low_vc_tbl, by = "plate_id", all.x = TRUE)
  knitr::kable(flagged_vc, row.names = FALSE,
               caption = "Plates flagged for too few kept vehicle-control wells.")
} else {
  cat("No plate flagged for kept vehicle-control wells.\n")
}
```

## Status

```{r}
#| label: status

if (sum(import_log$ok) == 0) {
  status <- "failed"
  status_reason <- "No input could be imported; see the import log."
} else if (any(!import_log$ok)) {
  status <- "needs_review"
  status_reason <- paste0(
    sum(!import_log$ok), " read unit(s) failed to import. Fix the source file(s) or ",
    "remove them from `input` in the yml, then re-render."
  )
} else if (length(unresolved) > 0) {
  status <- "needs_review"
  status_reason <- paste0(
    length(unresolved), " plate(s) failed per-plate QC and are not excluded: ",
    paste(unresolved, collapse = ", "),
    ". Review the diagnostics, then either fix the source data, declare wells the ",
    "provider already removed in `provider_removed_wells`, or add the plate(s) ",
    "to `exclude_plates` (with a reason) in the yml, and re-render."
  )
} else if (nrow(unresolved_flagged) > 0) {
  status <- "needs_review"
  status_reason <- paste0(
    nrow(unresolved_flagged), " well(s) flagged by the comment pattern are unresolved: ",
    paste(paste0(unresolved_flagged$plate_id, "/", unresolved_flagged$well_id), collapse = ", "),
    ". For each, add it to `remove_wells` (no larva / multiple larvae / technical failure) ",
    "or `keep_flagged_wells` (exactly one larva), with a reason, and re-render."
  )
} else if (length(unresolved_low_vc) > 0) {
  status <- "needs_review"
  status_reason <- paste0(
    length(unresolved_low_vc), " plate(s) have too few kept vehicle-control wells: ",
    paste(unresolved_low_vc, collapse = ", "),
    ". For each, add it to `exclude_plates` or `accept_low_vc_plates` (with a reason; ",
    "plates with no kept vehicle-control well can only be excluded), and re-render."
  )
} else {
  status <- "pending_dataset_qc"
  status_reason <- ""
}
```

```{r}
#| label: combine-and-dataset-qc

combined <- NULL
dataset_qc <- NULL
if (status == "pending_dataset_qc") {
  keep_ids <- setdiff(plate_qc_table$plate_id, excl_table$plate_id)
  combined <- imported[imported$plate_id %in% keep_ids, , drop = FALSE]
  n_rows_before_well_removal <- nrow(combined)
  combined <- combined[!well_key(combined) %in% well_key(remove_wells_tbl), , drop = FALSE]

  unique_id_cols <- as_chr(p$dataset_qc$unique_id_cols)
  expected_n_distinct <- if (is.null(p$dataset_qc$expected_n_distinct)) {
    list()
  } else {
    lapply(p$dataset_qc$expected_n_distinct, as.integer)
  }
  dataset_qc <- validate_combined_dataset(
    combined,
    unique_id_cols = unique_id_cols,
    plate_col = "plate_id",
    expected_n_distinct = expected_n_distinct
  )
  print(dataset_qc)

  if (isTRUE(dataset_qc$ok)) {
    status <- "complete"
    status_reason <- paste0(
      length(keep_ids), " plate(s) combined; ", nrow(excl_table), " excluded by user decision; ",
      nrow(remove_wells_tbl), " well(s) removed; ", nrow(provider_removed_tbl),
      " well(s) declared removed by the provider."
    )
  } else {
    status <- "needs_review"
    status_reason <- paste0(
      "Dataset-level QC failed (see checks above). Resolve the identifier/count ",
      "problem (or correct the expected values in the yml if they were wrong) and re-render."
    )
  }
}
```

```{r}
#| label: well-counts-per-plate

well_counts_per_plate <- NULL
if (!is.null(combined) && identical(status, "complete")) {
  wl <- unique(combined[, c("plate_id", "well_id", "keep_well")])
  delivered <- tapply(well_info$well_id, well_info$plate_id, length)
  well_counts_per_plate <- data.frame(
    plate_id = sort(unique(wl$plate_id)),
    stringsAsFactors = FALSE
  )
  pid <- well_counts_per_plate$plate_id
  well_counts_per_plate$n_wells_delivered <- as.integer(delivered[pid])
  well_counts_per_plate$n_provider_removed <- as.integer(
    vapply(pid, function(x) sum(provider_removed_tbl$plate_id == x), 1L)
  )
  well_counts_per_plate$n_removed <- as.integer(
    vapply(pid, function(x) sum(remove_wells_tbl$plate_id == x), 1L)
  )
  well_counts_per_plate$n_wells_output <- as.integer(table(wl$plate_id)[pid])
  well_counts_per_plate$n_keep_well_false <- as.integer(
    vapply(pid, function(x) sum(!wl$keep_well[wl$plate_id == x]), 1L)
  )
  affected <- well_counts_per_plate[
    well_counts_per_plate$n_provider_removed > 0 | well_counts_per_plate$n_removed > 0, , drop = FALSE
  ]
  knitr::kable(
    data.frame(
      plates = nrow(well_counts_per_plate),
      wells_output = sum(well_counts_per_plate$n_wells_output),
      wells_removed = sum(well_counts_per_plate$n_removed),
      wells_provider_removed = sum(well_counts_per_plate$n_provider_removed),
      keep_well_false = sum(well_counts_per_plate$n_keep_well_false),
      rows_output = nrow(combined)
    ),
    caption = "Output well counts (every output well holds exactly one larva)."
  )
}
```

```{r}
#| label: well-counts-affected

if (!is.null(well_counts_per_plate) && nrow(affected) > 0) {
  knitr::kable(affected, row.names = FALSE,
               caption = "Plates with removed or provider-removed wells.")
}
```

```{r}
#| label: concentration-units

# Report only (no status change): downstream skills that pool plates or
# compare concentrations need to know the units. Vehicle-control wells are
# ignored (their unit is not a dosing unit).
conc_units <- NULL
plates_mixed_units <- character(0)
if (!is.null(combined) && identical(status, "complete")) {
  if ("concentration_unit" %in% names(combined)) {
    tw <- unique(combined[!combined$is_vehicle_control, c("plate_id", "concentration_unit")])
    tw$concentration_unit[is.na(tw$concentration_unit)] <- "(missing)"
    per_plate <- tapply(tw$concentration_unit, tw$plate_id, function(u) paste(sort(unique(u)), collapse = " + "))
    plates_mixed_units <- names(per_plate)[grepl(" + ", per_plate, fixed = TRUE)]
    conc_units <- as.data.frame(table(concentration_unit = unname(per_plate)), stringsAsFactors = FALSE)
    names(conc_units)[2] <- "n_plates"
    conc_units$plates <- vapply(conc_units$concentration_unit, function(u) {
      ids <- sort(names(per_plate)[per_plate == u])
      if (length(ids) > 12) paste0(paste(ids[1:12], collapse = ", "), ", ...") else paste(ids, collapse = ", ")
    }, "")
    knitr::kable(conc_units, row.names = FALSE,
                 caption = "Concentration units of treated wells, per plate.")
  } else {
    cat("No `concentration_unit` column was mapped: concentration units are unknown.\n")
  }
}
```

```{r}
#| label: concentration-units-note

if (!is.null(conc_units)) {
  if (length(plates_mixed_units) > 0) {
    cat("WARNING: plate(s) with more than one concentration unit among treated wells:",
        paste(plates_mixed_units, collapse = ", "), "\n")
  } else if (nrow(conc_units) > 1) {
    cat("More than one concentration unit across plates. Plates in different units",
        "cannot be pooled or compared on one concentration axis.\n")
  } else {
    cat("All plates use one concentration unit.\n")
  }
}
```

## Save outputs

```{r}
#| label: save

# Remove stale downstream-facing output from a previous pass of this run.
combined_path <- out_path("combined", "rds")
if (file.exists(combined_path)) file.remove(combined_path)

save_rds(
  list(import_log = import_log, plate_qc_table = plate_qc_table, plate_results = plate_results),
  out_path("plate-qc", "rds")
)
save_rds(dataset_qc, out_path("dataset-qc", "rds"))
save_rds(
  list(
    keep_well_source = kw_source,
    keep_well_false_wells = false_wells_tbl,
    provider_removed_wells = provider_removed_tbl,
    provider_removed_check = provider_removed_check,
    remove_wells = remove_wells_tbl,
    removed_detail = removed_detail,
    keep_flagged_wells = keep_flagged_tbl,
    flag_comment_column = flag_col,
    flag_comment_pattern = flag_pattern,
    flagged = flagged,
    well_counts_per_plate = well_counts_per_plate,
    vc_usability = vc_usability,
    concentration_units = conc_units,
    min_kept_vc_pct = min_vc_pct,
    accept_low_vc_plates = accept_low_vc_tbl
  ),
  out_path("well-curation", "rds")
)
if (identical(status, "complete")) {
  save_rds(combined, combined_path)
}

outputs <- c(out_path("plate-qc", "rds"), out_path("dataset-qc", "rds"),
             out_path("well-curation", "rds"))
if (identical(status, "complete")) outputs <- c(outputs, combined_path)

md5 <- function(f) unname(tools::md5sum(f))
rel_to_root <- function(f) {
  # Only the project root is normalized; the file path is not (symlinked
  # raw-data folders should still be recorded under data/raw/...).
  prefix <- paste0(project_root, "/")
  if (startsWith(f, prefix)) substring(f, nchar(prefix) + 1) else f
}

manifest <- list(
  skill = skill,
  run_label = p$run_label,
  status = status,
  status_reason = status_reason,
  rendered_at = format(Sys.time(), "%Y-%m-%dT%H:%M:%S"),
  zfbehavior_version = as.character(utils::packageVersion("zfbehavior")),
  upstream = list(),
  inputs = lapply(input_files, function(f) list(path = rel_to_root(f), md5 = md5(f))),
  outputs = lapply(outputs, function(f) list(path = f, md5 = md5(f))),
  summary = list(
    n_plates_checked = nrow(plate_qc_table),
    n_plates_failed = sum(!plate_qc_table$ok),
    n_plates_excluded = nrow(excl_table),
    n_plates_accepted_with_provider_removed_wells = sum(plate_qc_table$accepted_with_provider_removed_wells),
    n_rows_combined = if (is.null(combined) || status != "complete") NULL else nrow(combined),
    n_wells_combined = if (is.null(well_counts_per_plate)) NULL else
      sum(well_counts_per_plate$n_wells_output),
    n_wells_removed = nrow(remove_wells_tbl),
    n_wells_flagged = nrow(flagged),
    n_wells_flagged_unresolved = nrow(unresolved_flagged),
    n_plates_low_vc_flagged = sum(vc_usability$flagged),
    vc_kept_pct_min = if (nrow(vc_usability) > 0) min(vc_usability$pct_vc_kept) else NULL
  ),
  # Units of treated wells (report only); NULL if no concentration_unit column.
  concentration_units = if (is.null(conc_units)) NULL else
    lapply(seq_len(nrow(conc_units)), function(i) list(
      unit = conc_units$concentration_unit[i], n_plates = conc_units$n_plates[i]
    )),
  plates_mixed_concentration_units = as.list(plates_mixed_units),
  # Output contract (CONVENTIONS.md): every well in combined.rds holds exactly
  # one larva; keep_well = FALSE means "one larva, dead/malformed".
  well_contract = "single_larva_wells_only",
  keep_well_source = kw_source,
  # Every combined plate has >= 1 kept VC well, and >= min_kept_vc_pct unless
  # listed in accepted_low_vc_plates.
  min_kept_vc_pct = min_vc_pct,
  accepted_low_vc_plates = lapply(seq_len(nrow(accept_low_vc_tbl)), function(i) as.list(accept_low_vc_tbl[i, ])),
  excluded_plates = lapply(seq_len(nrow(excl_table)), function(i) {
    list(plate_id = excl_table$plate_id[i], reason = excl_table$reason[i])
  }),
  removed_wells = lapply(seq_len(nrow(remove_wells_tbl)), function(i) as.list(remove_wells_tbl[i, ])),
  provider_removed_wells = lapply(seq_len(nrow(provider_removed_tbl)), function(i) as.list(provider_removed_tbl[i, ])),
  keep_flagged_wells = lapply(seq_len(nrow(keep_flagged_tbl)), function(i) as.list(keep_flagged_tbl[i, ])),
  keep_well_false_wells = lapply(seq_len(nrow(false_wells_tbl)), function(i) as.list(false_wells_tbl[i, ])),
  parameters = p[setdiff(names(p), c(
    "exclude_plates", "remove_wells", "provider_removed_wells",
    "keep_flagged_wells", "keep_well", "accept_low_vc_plates"
  ))]
)
yaml::write_yaml(manifest, out_path("manifest", "yml"))

knitr::kable(
  data.frame(output = c(outputs, out_path("manifest", "yml"))),
  caption = "Files written by this run."
)
```
